items.notes: Manual Onagraceae/Lamiaceae refresh PASS — Kew accepts Scutellaria ovata as a Texas-native species with infraspecific structure. Travis remains locked by UT Plant Resources Center specimens. The Smithsonian monographic treatment of North American Scutellaria records S. ovata var. bracteata from both Hays County (San Marcos) and Gillespie County; because the learner record is at species rank, accepted infraspecific records roll up to the species concept. Three exact project target-zone counties are therefore locked: Travis, Hays, Gillespie. Burnet field-photo evidence exists as additional support but is not needed for the threshold.
